Team,

For Cloudrest, our pet cabin stays at 24 degrees Celsius to support comfort throughout the journey. This setting is part of a wider welfare plan that the handlers follow with calm, humane handling methods around animals. The senior coordinator reviews each travel file for comfort needs before departure so Marley and every other companion animal get consistent care.

When you brief a traveler, lead with clear expectations and stay focused on predictable routines: gentle approaches, minimal lingering, and quick coordination with the welfare coordinator. Keep documentation accurate and complete, including any notes from the welfare review, and escalate only the specific concerns that affect a companion animal’s comfort or safety. If Layla Bianchi or Dylan Wilson asks about the cabin environment, confirm that the temperature control is already set to the standard without adding extra commentary.

Training remains about dependable execution. Please double-check carrier placement, airflow access, and secure seating before boarding, then monitor the animal-facing signals that indicate stress or discomfort. A smooth handoff between desk staff and ground handlers is the difference between a good day and a worry-free trip.
